verdict.rationale: Kit documents some of its own deliverability signals: an account-level bounce rate over the last 90 days, a subscriber.bounced webhook event, and DMARC status for sending addresses. Per-broadcast stats cover recipients, opens, clicks and unsubscribes but not bounces. missing for 10: per-send bounce metrics, complaint/spam-report signals, blocklist monitoring, actionable guidance or alerts when deliverability degrades, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades

citations.quote: Returns account-level email performance for the last 90 days: `sent`, `opened`, and `clicked` counts plus open, click, unsubscribe, and bounce rates
the account's sending addresses with their verification and DMARC status
